name: Henry County, IL
findings: Henry County has 173 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Henry County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
